mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 48 degrees and overcast near Harriet Park, under the glow of a Waning Crescent moon.

In city news, Public Works reminds us that asphalt repairs will take place on November 9 and 10, impacting Nine Mound Road, Morningside Boulevard, and Mozart Street. Also, the city continues to encourage residents to sign up for the digital newsletter to stay informed on local projects.

Today is a great day to get involved, with Yoga at Insight Wellness and the fun-filled ART House 360 events happening tonight. Looking ahead, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus tomorrow or live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard starting tomorrow as well.
Looking at the weekly police report, on October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old Verona man for O W I after discovering him unresponsive at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and treat yourself.
